title: Counter Time beside Pommel Strike: does it want more?
plain: Counter Time (25 Rage, needs the Defensive guard) still only makes one enemy lose its next turn and deals nothing, while the cheaper Pommel Strike stuns for the same one turn and hits too, so the call is whether Counter Time should get something extra.
options: A (recommended): leave it as it is until play shows nobody takes it; its edge is that it cannot miss, be parried or be blocked; B: give it a small extra (some Break damage, or a lower cost or cooldown) so it is not a weaker Pommel Strike; C: make stun length real so its two turns both count (moves every stun in the game)

evidence (the first reader, at HEAD 0ba1: every original rune is retired, splashes included (data/runes.json: 12 at EO §3, 53 at ET §1; ET.md:34 "RETIRE ALL 53"); Runes.breadth_met (runes.gd:803) has no caller
the second reader: settled: CONFIRMED — FN's designer ruling overturned ES §5's splash answer: no rune may carry a tag condition (CLAUDE.md:3485-3488). All 12 splash runes are retired in runes.json, and breadth_met (runes.gd:803) has no rune caller.

title: The lane-rune half: what replaces the lane rule's variance for the 36
plain: The 36 old lane runes no longer exist and today's runes are a newer set, so this question no longer applies; a rune keyed to tags stays possible if you ever want one.
evidence (the first reader, at HEAD 0ba1: all 36 lane runes retired (data/runes.json "retired" on each, EO §3 and ET §1); the 104 live runes are a later set rolled per class (runes.gd HC §1 note) with no lane field
the second reader: settled: CONFIRMED — All 36 lane-field runes are retired (ET §1, runes.json), and FN forbade the tag candidate (CLAUDE.md:3485-3488). Today's runes carry no lane and are scoped by class and engine, so the question's 36 no longer exist.

title: Rune pricing, now that a rune is worth the same to every hero
plain: You set one flat price of 150 gold for every rune at HK, so rune pricing is decided.
evidence (the first reader, at HEAD 0ba1: HK.md:54 quotes HK's brief: "A rune costs 150g" — "RULED AND BUILT"; data/runes.json: all 104 live runes "price": 150
the second reader: settled: CONFIRMED — Ruled flat: every rune has one price, 150g since HK's brief ('A rune costs 150g', HK.md:54), restated in FN's designer-ruled block (CLAUDE.md:3491). All 104 live runes read 150.

title: Boss pools stay thin; the fallback always pays
plain: A hero who already owns every card his class can be offered gets no boss reward at all; the award is skipped.
options: A (recommended, JY's ruling 17): accept the skip, which no run is known to reach; B: give gold or a rune in its place
evidence (the first reader, at HEAD 0ba1: run_state.gd:3296-3339 award_ability_pick falls back to the class draft pool when the boss pool is empty ("A ZONE-BOSS AWARD ALWAYS PAYS"), two tiers since GP; a hero on a class spine has no boss pool at all (run_state.gd:6601-6603)
the second reader: as built: REFUTED — Pools as thin as stated (classes.gd:193-246), but 'always pays' is false: once every offerable class card is owned the fallback is empty and the award skipped (run_state.gd:3338-3340), AWAIT-b1's case; the tiers merged at GP. OPEN.

title: The Devout's boss pool is 2, both draftable; eight lineages can run short
plain: The Devout's own boss list holds two cards he could also draft, so his boss rewards often come from the fallback; accepting keeps it that way.
evidence (the first reader, at HEAD 0ba1: classes.gd:237 "inquisitor": ["Sacred Resolve", "Bulwark of Fortitude"], both on his draft shelf (classes.gd:443); the fallback at run_state.gd:3338
the second reader: as built: CONFIRMED — classes.gd:237 the Devout's pool is Sacred Resolve and Bulwark of Fortitude, both in the Cleric draft pool; recomputed today: eight lineages can lose an award, the Warden and three Hunters cannot, 28 of 44 boss-only.

title: Holy is the only lineage with four protected cores (half right)
disposition: settled, kept with what is still live beside it
plain: Holy no longer starts with any cards of her own lineage, so the old "four cores" phrase is simply out of date.
evidence (the first reader, at HEAD 0ba1: classes.gd:1219 "holy": {"slots": 0, "enablers": []}; since GS §1 a lineage brings only its enablers (classes.gd:1182-1184)
the second reader: settled: CONFIRMED — Since GS §1 Holy opens with nothing: PROTECTED_CORES gives holy 0 slots and no enablers (classes.gd:1219). The phrase 'four protected cores', half right or not, describes nothing now; design-notes.md:10432 is dated history.

title: Move Sanctuary from Holy's boss pool to the Devout's (DY §1, not taken)
plain: Sanctuary, a party heal, is a Holy boss reward and not a Devout one; accepting leaves it there and the Devout's list at two.
evidence (the first reader, at HEAD 0ba1: classes.gd:236 "holy": ["Divine Plea", "Dawnbreak", "Sanctuary"]; classes.gd:237 the Devout's two; the move was never made
the second reader: as built: CONFIRMED — classes.gd:236-237 Sanctuary stays in Holy's boss pool; the Devout's holds two cards.

the second reader: as built: CONFIRMED — Bestial Wrath, Spirit Bond, Primal Surge, Call of the Wild and Mark of the Hunt (classes.gd:240-241) each carry a special and no damage or Break figure.

title: Deadfall's recast gap under Deadfall Network
disposition: settled, kept with what is still live beside it
plain: The talent that made this edge case possible is gone, so it cannot happen in today's game.
evidence (the first reader, at HEAD 0ba1: unit.gd:440 deadfall_network; no live rune (data/runes.json) and no talent (talents.gd) writes it since FX, so the cap at battle.gd:7479 stays 1 and the gap cannot open
the second reader: settled: CONFIRMED — Nothing writes deadfall_network: no node in talents.gd and no rune, live or retired, in runes.json. It stays 0 (unit.gd:440), so the cap at battle.gd:7479 is 1 and the gap's condition (network >= 2) cannot hold.

title: (1) Divine Wrath against Blessing of Zeal
plain: Divine Wrath stacks its damage boost on Blessing of Zeal's and was never priced against anything.
options: A (recommended, JY's ruling 16): leave it as it stands, judged in play; B: a batch proposes its price
evidence (the first reader, at HEAD 0ba1: classes.gd:463 Blessing of Zeal is a draft card on the Devout's shelf since GS §1, no longer his core (his one enabler is Divine Shield, classes.gd:1221); Divine Wrath ships as authored (classes.gd:6361-6364); the comment at classes.gd:452 still calls Zeal his core
the second reader: settled: REFUTED — Divine Wrath is unchanged (classes.gd:6360-6364), and its comment still says 'ruled on nowhere' (:448-460). Zeal becoming a draft card (:463) only removes EB's protected-core excuse. DZ's 'never priced against anything' and the 1.3225 stacking still stand.

the second reader: as built: CONFIRMED — classes.gd:6332-6334 Arcane Surge 15 Mana, cooldown 3, initiative 3.0, outside PURE_BUFFS (ability.gd:163); Hold the Line 30 Mana, cooldown 6 at 3.0 (classes.gd:6036-6038).

title: (3) Sanctuary overlaps Hymn of Hope, Holy's protected core heal
plain: Hymn of Hope is no longer a card Holy always starts with, so Sanctuary no longer duplicates something she always has; whether to move Sanctuary is BOSSPICK-q4.
evidence (the first reader, at HEAD 0ba1: GS §1 moved Hymn of Hope from Holy's opening kit to the draft shelf (classes.gd:435-438), offered only to a Mercy holder (classes.gd:811); holy "slots": 0 (classes.gd:1219); Sanctuary unchanged (classes.gd:6356-6359)
the second reader: settled: CONFIRMED — Hymn of Hope is no longer Holy's protected core: it is on her draft shelf since GS §1 (classes.gd:438), gated on Mercy (:811), and Holy has 0 slots (:1219). Sanctuary now overlaps an optional card. Owed: DY's proposal to move Sanctuary to the Devout's boss pool stays with the Devout's shortfall in THE BOSS-PICK POOLS.
